_comment: Third-party work no package manager lists: programs Lumen runs, data it bundles or shows, services it calls. Kept by hand; generate.py merges it with the crates, the npm packages and models.json. Licence texts are in texts/ (SPDX).

groups.title: Lumen
groups.intro: Lumen is free software. You may use, study, share and change it under the licence below.

items.name: Lumen
items.note: Copyright (C) 2026 Julian (JL Studios) and the Lumen contributors. The plugin SDK is MIT OR Apache-2.0. The RAW library photos-raw is LGPL-2.1.

groups.title: Programs Lumen runs
groups.intro: Separate programs Lumen ships beside itself and runs; each keeps its own licence. Their source code is available from the links given.

items.name: FFmpeg
items.note: This FFmpeg build includes x264 and x265 and is distributed under the GNU GPL version 3. Its source code is available at https://ffmpeg.org/download.html, and the build's configuration at https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/. Lumen runs FFmpeg as a separate program; you may replace it with your own build.

items.name: ExifTool
items.note: Copyright Phil Harvey. "This is free software; you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the same terms as Perl itself." Lumen runs ExifTool as a separate program.

groups.title: Maps, places and music
groups.intro: Data Lumen bundles, and services it asks when online detail or music search is switched on.

items.name: OpenStreetMap data
items.note: Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License.

items.name: OpenFreeMap
items.note: Online map tiles: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles, data from OpenStreetMap.

items.name: EOX Sentinel-2 cloudless
items.note: Satellite imagery: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025), under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-ShareAlike 4.0. A fork that sells Lumen must use other imagery.

items.name: Esri World Imagery
items.note: Detailed satellite imagery © Esri, Maxar, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community. Used only with your own ArcGIS Location Platform key (Settings → Connections → Map), under Esri's terms.

items.name: Photon
items.note: Online place search by komoot, built on OpenStreetMap data.

items.name: Nominatim
items.note: Exact place names, when switched on: OpenStreetMap's reverse geocoder. Names © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL).

items.name: Natural Earth
items.note: The offline world map. Made with Natural Earth. Free vector and raster map data @ naturalearthdata.com.

items.name: GeoNames
items.note: Place names for photos and the offline place search come from GeoNames (cities15000 and cities500), under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0.

items.name: Jamendo
items.note: Music found through Music search is provided by Jamendo. Each track is credited to its artist under its own Creative Commons licence, and the credit is saved beside every slideshow that uses it.

groups.title: Notices
